author: Praxis VI
title: Ablation: Praxis X_emb + DAQB adapter (k=50, kd=22, δ=0.12)
abstract: Construct Praxis-style embedding (FWPCA-weighted PCA60), then apply DAQB to that embedding via shared adapter to isolate graph-construction effect.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage/praxis','storage/shared'])
# Build Praxis-style embedding locally
from embedding_fwpca_knn import _to_dense_float32
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif
# DAQB adapter on an existing embedding
from adapters.apply_daqb_to_embedding import build_daqb_graph_from_embedding

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # Normalize + log1p from counts
    if 'counts' in adata.layers:
        adata.X = adata.layers['counts'].copy()
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4, inplace=True)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)

    # Praxis-style FWPCA weights using batch labels
    X = _to_dense_float32(adata.X)
    y = adata.obs['batch'].astype('category').cat.codes.to_numpy()
    f_scores, _ = f_classif(X, y)
    finite_mask = np.isfinite(f_scores)
    max_finite = np.max(f_scores[finite_mask]) if np.any(finite_mask) else 1.0
    f_scores = np.nan_to_num(f_scores, nan=0.0, posinf=max_finite)
    w = f_scores.astype(np.float32) / (np.mean(f_scores) + 1e-8)

    # PCA(60) to get embedding
    Xw = X * w[None, :]
    ad_emb = ad.AnnData(Xw, obs=adata.obs[['batch']].copy())
    sc.pp.pca(ad_emb, n_comps=60, svd_solver='arpack', random_state=0)
    X_emb = np.asarray(ad_emb.obsm['X_pca'], dtype=np.float32)
    adata.obsm['X_emb'] = X_emb

    # Apply DAQB to the embedding (parameters aligned with Praxis baseline)
    C, D = build_daqb_graph_from_embedding(
        X_emb,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        delta=0.12,
        metric='cosine',
        cap=2.0,
        seed=0
    )
    adata.obsp['connectivities'] = C
    adata.obsp['distances'] = D
    adata.uns['neighbors'] = {
        'connectivities_key': 'connectivities',
        'distances_key': 'distances',
        'params': {'n_neighbors': 50, 'method': 'DAQB(adapter)', 'metric': 'cosine'}
    }
    return adata
